fields.description: Flash username this discount applies to (matched case-insensitively; verified against flash and canonicalized on create and rename). Fixed after creation; use the Rename dialog to change it.
fields.label: Username

fields.description: Percentage taken OFF the Flash fee (not off the gross amount). 100 waives the Flash fee entirely; processor fees still apply.
fields.label: Flash Fee Discount (%)

fields.description: Uncheck to suspend the discount without deleting the row.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Apply to Fygaro card top-ups (discounts the Flash margin on auto-credit).
fields.label: Applies to Card Top-Ups

fields.description: Apply to Jamaican bank cashouts (discounts the Flash service fee on the offer).
fields.label: Applies to Bank Cashouts

fields.description: Set automatically: 1 once flash confirmed the username exists, 0 when the check could not run (flash unreachable or not configured). Unverified rows may silently never discount — filter on this, then open a row, change a field (Desk skips the save entirely on an untouched doc) and save to re-run the check: it flips to 1 if flash now knows the username, and stays 0 — with a warning, never a rejected save — if flash is still unreachable or still does not know it. Fix a wrong username via the Rename dialog.
fields.label: Verified Against Flash

fields.description: Set automatically from the flash account found at verification time. The username is mutable on the flash side; this is not — it is what makes a stale row detectable in one query.
fields.label: Flash Account UUID

fields.description: Why this user gets a discount (who approved it, until when, etc.).
fields.label: Notes
